I believe that, depending on the business cycle, at times, business needs to be taxed less and allowed to keep more profit than at other times and vice versa. I believe that the economic model is there to serve, ultimately, the worker/consumer who are the Golden Goose of the system.

Finally, I think that politics should grasp the bigger picture and direct government to respond in a wise way to solving problems that the private sector's myopia prevents businesses at large from addressing. This means that political decisions, if driven by a wise understanding of the bigger picture, should be mandating a NEGATIVE GDP and a dramatic shift away from fossil fuels.

That is my political compass in a nut shell.
